name: retrieval-hybrid-v2
hypothesis: Fusing BM25 and vector rankings raises development Recall@10 above both baselines, because their top-10 lists retrieve different relevant papers (union Recall@10 0.760 in retrieval-development-20260923T234633Z).

method.rrf_k_source: Cormack, Clarke and Buettcher (SIGIR 2009) default; not tuned here
method.unit_reported: the unit from the method that ranked the paper higher

single_configuration: Exactly this configuration is run. If it is not adopted, no variant (other rrf_k, weights, or depths) is tried on the same development questions without registering it as a new configuration and reporting every configuration tried.
